scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run preview -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
